assertions.claim: From January 2026, messaging or lying in wait after an explicit refusal is a public-security violation
assertions.cn_span: 对方明确拒绝之后还发消息、还去等人，2026 年 1 月起就是治安违法

assertions.claim: Punishment: up to 5 days detention or fine up to 1000 yuan; serious cases 5-10 days
assertions.cn_span: 拘留 5 日以下或罚 1000 元以下，情节较重拘留 5 到 10 日

assertions.claim: Police may also order a no-contact period; violating it means another 5-10 days detention
assertions.cn_span: 公安还可以责令你一段时间内禁止接触对方，违反禁止接触的规定再拘留 5 到 10 日

assertions.claim: Such records affect civil-service exams, public-institution posts, political vetting and some professional licenses
assertions.cn_span: 这类记录还会影响考公、考编、政审和一些职业的从业资格

assertions.claim: Statute quote: repeated obscene/insulting/threatening messages or harassing/stalking methods disturbing normal life: up to 5 days or 1000 yuan; serious cases 5-10 days
assertions.cn_span: 「多次发送淫秽、侮辱、恐吓等信息或者采取滋扰、纠缠、跟踪等方法，干扰他人正常生活的」，处五日以下拘留或者一千元以下罚款，情节较重的处五日以上十日以下拘留

assertions.claim: 'Persisting to the end will move them' has no research support
assertions.cn_span: 「死追到底会感动对方」没有任何研究支持

assertions.claim: The line between courting and harassment is set by whether the person clearly refused, not by your motives
assertions.cn_span: 追一个人和骚扰一个人的分界线不由你的动机决定，由对方是否已经明确表示拒绝决定
